nodes.label: Vulkan base pinned to RenoDX PR #564 commit 92d6d79ec8103b1aaea44c0085c3a88db723e6d5.
nodes.norm_label: vulkan base pinned to renodx pr #564 commit 92d6d79ec8103b1aaea44c0085c3a88db723e6d5.

nodes.label: Requires ReShade 6.8.0 Full Add-On and the game's native Vulkan renderer.
nodes.norm_label: requires reshade 6.8.0 full add-on and the game's native vulkan renderer.

nodes.label: Adds NVIDIA NGX DLAA at native resolution with a separate HDR-safe sharpening control; the in-game Resolution Scaling setting must be 100%, and reduced render extents fail closed to native TAA.
nodes.norm_label: adds nvidia ngx dlaa at native resolution with a separate hdr-safe sharpening control; the in-game resolution scaling setting must be 100%, and reduced render extents fail closed to native taa.

nodes.label: Adds opt-in native DOF v2 with Clean, Cinematic, and Retinal styles. Enhanced styles use full-resolution far-focus boundaries while preserving Detroit's authored foreground bokeh at the exact Vanilla strength; Cinematic restores authored far color through a full-resolution Gaussian CoC gradient while half-resolution R8 far alpha is restricted to color validation and never controls visibility, preventing moving silhouette masks and uniform gameplay haze, then restores confirmed deep background bokeh, while Retinal adds a full-resolution Watson acuity filter with paired hardware-linear Gaussian taps. Vanilla remains the exact default path, and unsupported or incomplete shader chains fail closed.
nodes.norm_label: adds opt-in native dof v2 with clean, cinematic, and retinal styles. enhanced styles use full-resolution far-focus boundaries while preserving detroit's authored foreground bokeh at the exact vanilla strength; cinematic restores authored far color through a full-resolution gaussian coc gradient while half-resolution r8 far alpha is restricted to color validation and never controls visibility, preventing moving silhouette masks and uniform gameplay haze, then restores confirmed deep background bokeh, while retinal adds a full-resolution watson acuity filter with paired hardware-linear gaussian taps. vanilla remains the exact default path, and unsupported or incomplete shader chains fail closed.

nodes.label: The addon now embeds the Vulkan/NGX bootstrap. No launcher, separate Vulkan layer, global registration, or Steam launch option is required.
nodes.norm_label: the addon now embeds the vulkan/ngx bootstrap. no launcher, separate vulkan layer, global registration, or steam launch option is required.

nodes.label: The first launch configures ADDON.LoadFromDllMain and caches verified NGX Vulkan extension requirements; restart once before enabling DLAA.
nodes.norm_label: the first launch configures addon.loadfromdllmain and caches verified ngx vulkan extension requirements; restart once before enabling dlaa.

nodes.label: The release package contains renodx-detroitbecomehuman.addon64 and the official nvngx_dlss.dll. DLSS Super Resolution, Frame Generation and Streamline are not included.
nodes.norm_label: the release package contains renodx-detroitbecomehuman.addon64 and the official nvngx_dlss.dll. dlss super resolution, frame generation and streamline are not included.

nodes.label: Adds an automatic, reversible aspect-ratio override and isolated Scaleform UI compensation for displays wider than 16:9; 3440x1440 uses its exact 43:18 ratio.
nodes.norm_label: adds an automatic, reversible aspect-ratio override and isolated scaleform ui compensation for displays wider than 16:9; 3440x1440 uses its exact 43:18 ratio.

nodes.label: RenoDX Preset Off disables HDR look changes but keeps ultrawide compatibility active; select Aspect Ratio: Vanilla 16:9 to disable the geometry override.
nodes.norm_label: renodx preset off disables hdr look changes but keeps ultrawide compatibility active; select aspect ratio: vanilla 16:9 to disable the geometry override.

nodes.label: Ultrawide signatures and scaling were independently reimplemented from research published by Rose / PCGamingWiki; no trainer binary or Cheat Engine payload is included.
nodes.norm_label: ultrawide signatures and scaling were independently reimplemented from research published by rose / pcgamingwiki; no trainer binary or cheat engine payload is included.

nodes.label: Fully restart the game after adding, replacing, or removing the addon; live addon unload/reload is not supported.
nodes.norm_label: fully restart the game after adding, replacing, or removing the addon; live addon unload/reload is not supported.

nodes.label: Auto HDR and NVIDIA RTX HDR must be disabled. Late chapters remain user-validation for this experimental RC.
nodes.norm_label: auto hdr and nvidia rtx hdr must be disabled. late chapters remain user-validation for this experimental rc.
